programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie présentent les iCarly Awards. Ils récompensent en direct les auteurs des meilleurs contenus envoyés sur le site.

programme.title: Mélanie
programme.desc: Surprise, surprise ! Sam a une sœur jumelle appelée Mélanie. Et encore plus surprenant, elle est beaucoup plus féminine que Sam, et craque pour Freddie, qui la prend pour Sam déguisée.

programme.title: Carly et Clyde
programme.desc: Griffin, le nouveau voisin de Carly et Spencer, vole la moto que Carly a offert à Spencer.

programme.title: contre Dingo Channel
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie découvrent qu'une émission de télé sur Dingo Channel plagie des contenus d'iCarly. Ils décident alors de se rendre à Los Angeles pour confronter les auteurs de l'émission.

programme.title: Laveu
programme.desc: Sous l'influence d'un gaz hilarant chez le dentiste, Sam parle à Carly de son baiser avec Freddie.

programme.title: Le concours de cuisine
programme.desc: Carly et Sam utilisent la recette de taco aux spaghettis de Spencer à l'occasion d'un concours télévisé avec un grand Chef.

programme.title: Le principal Franklin
programme.desc: Après que le Principal Franklin se soit fait renvoyer accidentellement à cause de Carly, Sam et Freddie, Mme Briggs et Mr Howard prennent le contrôle de l'école et instaurent des règles sévères ainsi qu'un code vestimentaire.

programme.title: Le bal des Demoiselles
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie organisent un speed dating afin de choisir celui qui accompagnera Carly à un bal. Pendant ce temps, Spencer suit un curieux régime.

programme.title: La Pop Star
programme.desc: Carly et ses amis tentent d'aider une ancienne pop star à réaliser la vidéo de son grand retour.

programme.title: Freddy, mon héros
programme.desc: Freddy sauve Carly qui était sur le point de se faire percuter par un camion. Elle tombe alors amoureuse de lui.

programme.title: Metamorphosis
programme.desc: Trois jeunes voyagent à travers la campagne hongroise dans l'espoir d'étayer la thèse au sujet de la légendaire Comtesse Elizabeth Bathory, réputée pour s'être baignée dans le sang au XVIIème siècle. Mais ils se perdent sur le retour, jusqu'à ce qu'une étrange jeune femme leur propose de les conduire au château Bathory.

programme.title: Cercle Infernal
programme.desc: La vie de deux sœurs change radicalement, depuis qu'elles ont été hypnotisées par un disque vinyle mystique des années 1970.

programme.title: The Battery
programme.desc: Au cours d'un road-trip à travers les Etats-Unis, au cours duquel ils doivent faire face à des morts-vivants, deux anciens joueurs de base-ball s'aperçoivent qu'ils devront aussi faire face à leurs propres démons.

programme.title: The House at the End of Time
programme.desc: Dulce est une jeune mère qui a des hallucinations. Elle voit des apparitions dans sa maison qui un jour déclenche la prophétie et tue tous les habitants sauf elle. Trente ans plus tard elle se réinstalle dans sa demeure afin d'élucider le mystère.

programme.title: Sherlock Gnomes
programme.desc: Les adorables nains de jardin de «Gnoméo et Juliette» sont de retour pour une toute nouvelle aventure à Londres. Quand Gnoméo et Juliette arrivent en ville avec leurs amis et leur famille, leur préoccupation principale est de préparer leur jardin pour le printemps.

programme.title: Zip & Zap
programme.desc: Zip et Zap, deux jumeaux très turbulents, toujours prêts à faire les quatre cents coups, sont punis et envoyés dans un camp d'été très particulier.

programme.title: L'Odyssée d'Albert: Chapitre 1
programme.desc: Chris, un adolescent aventureux, aide un gentil dinosaure à échapper aux griffes d'un scientifique fou, le docteur Jost, qui veut utiliser l'animal à des fins d'expérimentation.

programme.title: Cloudboy
programme.desc: Nila vient d'avoir douze ans, a toujours vécu en ville avec son père. Cet été, il se voit contraint de partir en vacances à la montagne dans le nord de la Suède avec sa mère qu'il ne connait presque pas.

programme.title: Foxter & Max
programme.desc: Un pré-adolescent artistique et frustré découvre que le chien graffiti qu'il a peint avec une boîte trouvée de ce qu'il pensait être de la peinture en aérosol, a pris vie sous la forme d'un super-chien ultra-intelligent fait de nanobots.

programme.title: Undercover Punch and Gun
programme.desc: Wu, policier infiltré au sein d'un réseau de méthamphétamine, doit s'associer à une bande hétéroclite pour faire tomber un énorme trafic de drogue.

programme.title: Night Shift
programme.desc: Une nuit explosive durant laquelle un vétéran chevronné de la police de Los Angeles emmène un jeune bleu en patrouille et lui montre la brutale réalité de leur métier...

programme.title: Survive
programme.desc: Jane et Paul sont les seuls rescapés d'un crash d'avion sur une montagne enneigée. Ils vont devoir se battre contre les éléments au péril de leur vie pour regagner la civilisation.

programme.title: Le Combat Final
programme.desc: Anthony Rodriguez, un jeune homme mi-italien mi-portoricain, est initié à la boxe par un ténor de la mafia quand sa mère meurt et que son père violent et alcoolique est chassé de la ville.

programme.title: Je sens le beat qui monte en moi
programme.desc: Rosalba, jeune guide touristique, souffre d'une affection étrange : la moindre mélodie provoque chez elle gesticulation et danse de façon aussi subtile qu'incontrôlable. Malgré ses ruses pour cacher son excentricité, ce corps indomptable pourrait bien séduire son surprenant collègue Alain...

programme.title: Rocambolesque
programme.desc: Au milieu du XIXe siècle, face à un éditeur qui refuse obstinément de l'augmenter, que peut bien faire le jeune auteur Ponson du Terrail… si ce n'est mettre dans la balance le destin de Rocambole, le héros de son feuilleton quotidien ?

programme.title: 2 minutes 30
programme.desc: Syrie, 2011. Nour passe le soir de Noël dans un appartement d'Homs avec un groupe de journalistes. Cette jeune pigiste française manque d'argent et veut sortir pour travailler. Mais dehors, c'est la guerre

programme.title: Trop de bruits qui courent
programme.desc: Evry, novembre 2015, quelques jours après les attentats de Paris. Ryad, seize ans,« n'assume pas » sa copine Sabrina: il a honte de se montrer amoureux devant ses copains du quartier. Le vol d'une vidéo sur son portable va pourtant le pousser à changer.

programme.title: Belle à jamais
programme.desc: Ville : Yaoundé. Adresse : Etoudi, carrefour du palais. C'est en arrivant dans cette maison où j'allais vivre pendant cinq semaines que j'ai décidé de filmer ses habitants : Dolvie, Daniella, Gaelle, Mirabelle, Raphaella, Ingrid, Sophie et Loic. Tous vivent chez Honorine, mais seule Gaelle est sa « vraie » fille. Pourtant ici, tout le monde appelle Honorine « maman ».

programme.title: La table
programme.desc: Un menuisier perfectionniste est obsédé par l'idée de créer un objet idéal.

programme.title: Petit homme
programme.desc: En plein nuit, Marc part furieux au volant de sa voiture.

programme.title: Iceberg
programme.desc: M. Elys travaille depuis vingt ans dans une patinoire où il a élu domicile. Il mène une vie sans but au volant de sa surfateuse à glace. Jusqu'au jour où il se heurte à Brie, une gamine farouche et obstinée.Il va lui ouvrir les portes de la patinoire sans se douter des conséquences.

programme.title: Ce qui nous éloigne
programme.desc: Après une longue séparation, une rencontre. Deux familles. Un enfant.

programme.title: Flirt
programme.desc: Quentin et son meilleur ami, Antoine, entrent en classe de troisième. Quentin a une copine. Chloé. Celle-ci ne laisse pas insensible Thomas, le petit caïd du collège. Le monde de l'enfance se fissure définitivement pour Quentin.

programme.title: De l'esprit d'équipe
programme.desc: Plongée documentaire au sein de “Pro Spectre”, l'entreprise de chasseurs de fantômes de Gilles et Joël.

programme.title: Taupes
programme.desc: Un groupe de gangsters est poursuivi après avoir dérobé un fabuleux trésor. Alors qu'ils s'enfoncent et s'égarent dans une mystérieuse forêt, ils deviennent peu à peu des figures légendaires...

programme.title: Mazeppa
programme.desc: Johan, un pianiste doué mais peu sûr de lui, s'apprête à passer un important concours musical. Submergé par le stress, il se réfugie dans les toilettes des filles où il fait la connaissance d'une jeune femme qui lui offre un tout autre destin.

programme.title: La fin du dragon
programme.desc: Marianne, Mike et Angèle sont réunis autour de leur mère. D'ici dix jours, après l'arrêt des machines qui la maintiennent dans le coma, Claudine sera morte. Dix jours ? Marianne n'avait pas compris que ça durerait tant…

programme.title: Blinis !
programme.desc: Eva, Manon et Garance se retrouvent la veille de Noël pour préparer des blinis selon l'authentique recette de leur grand-mère russe. Entre chants et danses, rires et pleurs, féérie de Noël et réalité sociale, les affinités évoluent au fil des sujets abordés.

programme.title: Fukushima, 5 ans après
programme.desc: Cinq ans après l'accident nucléaire qui a touché la préfecture de Fukushima, la vie continue pour les habitants.

programme.title: Silence
programme.desc: Un soir enneigé, Fred, trentenaire fatigué, rencontre un étrange individu.

programme.title: Escale
programme.desc: Deux femmes se font face. Deux chemins se croisent.

programme.title: Je suis orientée
programme.desc: Une adolescente passe un entretien pour faire le choix de son futur métier.

programme.title: Scintillant dans l'ombre
programme.desc: Hervé, un chauffeur routier solitaire, transporte une mystérieuse caisse jusqu'à un parc zoologique. Quelque chose ne tourne pas rond avec sa cargaison.

programme.title: Les cowboys n'ont pas peur de mourir
programme.desc: Que Valence et Michel attaquent une diligence, c'est normal. Que Valence en revienne avec une balle dans le ventre, c'est pas étonnant. Mais quand la vie met des heures et des heures à quitter son corps de cow-boy, là, y a maldonne.

programme.title: L'Ascension D'un Homme De Main
programme.desc: L'histoire vraie de Carlton Leach jeune hooligan Anglais qui intègre un des gangs les plus connus du pays à la fin des années 80. Il grimpe alors les échelons au point de devenir le criminel le plus respecté mais aussi détesté. Il devra faire face à ses propres démons lors de cette montée en puissance vers le grand banditisme et tout faire pour éviter la prison.

programme.title: Far away: les soldats de l'espoir
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie. Jun Shik travaille à la ferme du grand-père de Tatsuo alors que la Corée est colonisée par le Japon, mais il rêve de participer aux Jeux olympiques de Tokyo en tant que coureur de marathon. Tatsuo vise également à devenir marathonien, ce qui crée une rivalité entre eux. Mais la guerre éclate et ils sont tous deux forcés de s'enrôler dans l'armée. Tatsuo devient chef de la défense dans l'unité de Jun Shik et élabore un plan qui échoue. Jun Shik et Tatsuo sont capturés par les Soviétiques. Ils s'échappent mais sont rapidement capturés par les Allemands et forcés de se séparer. En 1944, ils se retrouvent sur les plages de Normandie.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond est un blanchisseur d'argent à New York qui se réveille sans aucun souvenir, avec des millions de dollars en espèces volées et de la drogue. Il doit rapidement parcourir les rues à la recherche de réponses tout en essayant d'échapper à une équipe de policiers violents et corrompus.

programme.title: HYENA ROAD
programme.desc: Les forces armées canadiennes sont chargées de sécuriser un territoire taliban dans la province de Kandahar, dans le sud de l'Afghanistan.

programme.title: Paradise Lost
programme.desc: Des jeunes touristes américains prennent du bon temps au Brésil à l'occasion de leurs vacances. La détente tourne court lorsque leur bus est pris dans un accident... Ils doivent alors trouver rapidement un refuge. Ils atteignent une plage paradisiaque mais ils se font dépouiller pendant la nuit ! De nouveaux évènements étranges et très inquiétants commencent à se produire et les membres du groupe réalisent que leurs vies sont en très grand danger...

programme.title: Les Regrets
programme.desc: Mathieu Lievin, 40 ans, architecte parisien, prend la route pour rejoindre la petite ville de son enfance où sa mère vient d'être hospitalisée en urgence. Dans la rue, il croise Maya, son amour de jeunesse, qu'il n'a pas revue depuis quinze années. Accompagnée d'un homme et d'une petite fille, elle ne lui adresse pas la parole. Deux heures plus tard, le téléphone sonne dans la maison familiale : c'est Maya qui l'invite à venir la retrouver chez elle. Il hésite un court instant puis accepte..

programme.title: Alice Through The Looking Glass
programme.desc: Dans ce conte classique, Alice tombe à travers un miroir et arrive dans un endroit merveilleux appelé le Pays des Merveilles ! Le voyage d'Alice à travers les huit carrés fous du Pays des Merveilles est présenté à l'écran dans un film d'animation de haute qualité, divertissant pour vos enfants et votre famille. En chemin, Alice rencontre des amis comme Bonnet blanc, et des ennemis tels que le méchant Jaseroque et le Bandersnatch !

programme.title: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: Ben emménage dans une nouvelle maison. L'adolescent se lie d'amitié avec leur nouveau voisin, qui est en fait le célèbre magicien Merlin. Alors que ce dernier affronte la terrible fée Morgane, il enseigne à Ben les rudiments de la magie.

programme.title: Le bal des folles
programme.desc: Au 19e siècle, une femme qui a le don unique d'entendre et de voir les morts est internée dans un asile psychiatrique, sans possibilité de s'échapper.

programme.title: Troupe d'élite
programme.desc: Inspiré des vrais faits de la Batalhão de Operações Policiais Especiais (BOPE), le Bataillon des opérations spéciales de la police militaire de Rio de Janeiro.

programme.title: The Interview
programme.desc: Dave et son équipe ils découvrent que le dirigeant nord-coréen Kim Jong-un est un fan de leur show...

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Michael Meyers est libéré de l'hôpital psychiatrique où il a été interné pendant 17 ans et se lance dans une course effrénée pour retrouver sa jeune sœur. Personne n'est à l'abri.

programme.title: Halloween 2
programme.desc: Après avoir passé 15 ans dans un asile d'aliénés pour la folie meurtrière de sa ville natale à la veille d'Halloween, Michael Meyers semble maintenant indestructible et s'en prend à sa sœur et à ceux qui cherchent à la protéger.

programme.title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
programme.desc: Un fabricant de jouets maléfique prévoit de vendre des millions de masques qui tueront tous les enfants qui les porteront à Halloween.

programme.title: La talentueuse Mademoiselle Cooper
programme.desc: Un prince, et héritier du trône, se trouve dans une impasse suite à une soirée qui a mal tourné. La famille royale fait donc appel à une excellente responsable en communication pour redorer son image ternie. Alors que la consultante se rend chez le prince, elle tombe malade et demande à son assistante d'y aller à sa place. Cette dernière – à l'insu de sa patronne- excelle dans la création de campagne de relations publiques du prince. Mais quand l'assistante tombe amoureuse de lui et que ses sentiments sont réciproques, elle doit lui révéler la vérité et voir ce qui arrivera quand il saura.

programme.title: Dirty 30
programme.desc: C'est un peu l'impasse dans la vie des amies de toujours Kate (Mamrie Hart), Evie (Grace Helbig) et Charlie (Hannah Hart). A la veille de son trentième anniversaire, Kate accepte de laisser Evie et Charlie lui organiser une fête. Pourtant, ce qui devait être une simple fête d'anniversaire part complètement en vrille.

programme.title: Delirious
programme.desc: Les Galantine, paparazzo new-yorkais, traque les people pour obtenir LA photo exclusive. Lors d'une poursuite de la pop star K'harma Leeds, il rencontre Toby, jeune SDF paumé, et accepte de l'engager comme assistant, entraînant de nouvelles opportunités.

programme.title: Seuls sur Terre
programme.desc: Del pense être le dernier homme sur Terre suite à une catastrophe qui a décimé l'humanité. Mais son isolement est contrarié par l'arrivée d'une jeune fille.

programme.title: 119 Jours : Les Survivants De Locean
programme.desc: L'histoire vraie de quatre hommes, ayant vécu l'enfer durant 119 jours au beau milieu de l'océan Pacifique, après que leur trimaran, le Rose Noelle, ait chaviré au cours d'une tempête en 1989.

programme.title: Bleeding Steel
programme.desc: Une invention biochimique permet de sauver la fille de Lin Dong. Mais elle est convoitée par un mystérieux groupe criminel. Lin Dong va tout faire pour la protéger des criminels qui la traque.

programme.title: Le 12ème Homme
programme.desc: Durant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, douze membres de la Résistance embarquent à bord d'un bateau de pêche pour saboter des installations militaires allemandes en mer du Nord. Tous sont capturés et torturés, sauf l'un d'entre eux qui réussit à s'échapper.

programme.title: Walt Disney, le rêveur éveillé
programme.desc: Mêlant archives et interviews, ce documentaire dévoile qui était l'homme derrière le légendaire Walt Disney.

programme.title: Get a Job
programme.desc: Jeunes diplômés tout juste sortis de l'université, Will (Teller) et Jillian (Kendrick) se voient rapidement confrontés aux obstacles auxquels les jeunes font face aujourd'hui sur un marché de l'emploi où la concurrence fait rage.

programme.title: Je suis à toi
programme.desc: Lucas, un jeune argentin démuni, fait tout ce qu'il peut pour survivre à Buenos Aires. Sur internet, il rencontre Henry, un boulanger belge qui souffre de solitude et qui rêve de le sauver de la prostitution.

programme.title: Permanent Midnight
programme.desc: Basé sur l'autobiographie acclamée du même nom, PERMANENT MIDNIGHT met en vedette Ben Stiller et Elizabeth Hurley dans cette histoire passionnante sur un écrivain de télévision chaud qui apprend de première main le côté sombre du succès à Hollywood.

programme.title: Une nouvelle chance (2016)
programme.desc: Un avenir de jeune chef tendait les bras à Charlie. Pourtant sa vie semble s'être suspendue, habitant avec sa mère et son beau-père et travaillant dans le cinéma de son quartier, Charlie n'a plus de motivation pour rien...

programme.title: Little Manhattan
programme.desc: Dans une ville connue pour son effervescence, deux jeunes amis sont sur le point de se lancer dans la plus grande des aventures. Gabe et Rosemary se connaissent depuis presque toujours, mais lorsqu'ils se retrouvent face à face lors d'un cours de karaté, ils se voient sous un jour nouveau.

programme.title: A quoi pensent les hommes?
programme.desc: Maja avocate spécialisée dans les divorces vit seule avec son fils Niklas et a renoncé aux hommes après une déception de trop. Aujourd'hui sa première affaire dans un nouveau cabinet est une véritable surprise : L'avocat de l'autre partie est Hanno - une ancienne flamme de Maja. Mais en se réveillant après un accident de voiture elle se rend compte qu'elle peut soudain entendre les pensées de tous les hommes autour d'elle. Cela lui offre de nouvelles opportunités pour sa vie privée ainsi que pour son travail.

programme.title: L'auberge de Noël
programme.desc: Deux agents immobiliers se disputent la même annonce et doivent passer du temps ensemble dans une auberge à Noël.

programme.title: Taj mahal
programme.desc: À 18 ans, Louise loge avec sa famille dans une suite du Taj Mahal Palace. Un soir, restée seule dans sa chambre, elle entend des bruits étranges dans les couloirs de l'hôtel. Elle comprend au bout de quelques minutes qu'il s'agit d'une attaque terroriste.

programme.title: L'homme de ma vie et moi
programme.desc: Niki anime un podcast bien connu sur les relations amoureuses. Lorsqu'un grand éditeur la contacte pour un éventuel contrat de livre, elle se retrouve en difficulté car le podcast est basé sur sa relation avec un petit ami imaginaire, Monsieur Parfait. Elle a besoin d'un remplaçant...

programme.title: Le Café de l'Amour
programme.desc: La propriétaire d'un café où tout le monde tombe amoureux risque de tout perdre lorsqu'une célébrité fait sa demande en mariage et se fait larguer. Elle décide alors de tout faire pour réconcilier le couple.

programme.title: Élections, Les Nouveaux Réseaux de la Désinformation
programme.desc: Plongez dans le monde de Telegram, le réseau préféré des complotistes.

programme.title: Too Much Flesh
programme.desc: Deuxième volet d'une trilogie dont la thématique est la liberté.

programme.title: Le Convoi des Alliés
programme.desc: En 1942, le convoi pq-17 est attaqué par les allemands et entre tragiquement dans la légende.

programme.title: The Road Within
programme.desc: Vincent, atteint du syndrome de Gilles de la Tourette, rencontre Marie et Alex dans une clinique.

programme.title: Intimate with a Stranger
programme.desc: Jack Hamilton est un gigolo, et à en juger par son agenda, pas des moindres.

programme.title: Monsieur Noël et moi
programme.desc: Zoé convainc Sam, libraire discret, de participer au concours « Monsieur Noël » afin de promouvoir son agence. Mais au fil des épreuves festives, leur relation devient bien plus personnelle.

programme.title: Saisis ta chance à Noël
programme.desc: Sutton, mère célibataire, doit passer les fêtes de fin d'année à trouver de nouveaux clients pour sa maison d'édition. Son fils, Jae, profite de sa magie de Noël pour lui montrer qu'elle peut trouver quelqu'un qui saura combler son cœur et lui décrocher un livre qui changera sa carrière.

programme.title: Coup de foudre royal à Noël
programme.desc: La princesse Camille se rend en Amérique pour créer un programme d'échange interculturel universitaire et tombe amoureuse du professeur Rhette Davis, mais lorsqu'elle découvre qu'il a été engagé par son père pour l'escorter, autrement dit pour la garder, elle se demande s'il se soucie plus d'elle ou de sa carrière.

programme.title: La destination de Noël
programme.desc: Emma, dirigeante épuisée d'une entreprise de jouets, rêve d'échapper à Noël. Mais une erreur d'avion l'emmène dans une ville d'Alaska entièrement dédiée aux fêtes, où Connor pourrait lui redonner goût à Noël.

programme.title: La Retraite de l'Amour
programme.desc: Jenny, créatrice de contenu, participe à une retraite d'entreprise à Miami pour sauver l'image d'une marque de cosmétiques. Entre ambition et romance avec Nate, le frère de son patron, tout se complique.

programme.title: Ma Vie Sans Lui

programme.title: Caitlin Moran On How She Finally Calmed Her Nervous System
programme.desc: Writer Caitlin Moran discusses her 30-year battle with anxiety that began at age 13, and how she's now two years anxiety-free through choosing to be hopeful and see the good in life. She talks with Fearne Cotton about how social media has altered our perception of reality, the difference between posting angrily online and taking real-world action, social anxiety when meeting friends, and how presuming everyone's having a bad day can make you happier.

programme.title: Ashley Roberts On Coping With Anxiety And Insomnia
programme.desc: Ashley Roberts discusses her journey through burnout and body shaming during the height of the Pussycat Dolls' fame, and how discovering breathwork helped her recover from intense anxiety and physical ill-health. She talks about her mental health toolkit, the grief of losing her dad to suicide, and family mental illness. With Fearne Cotton, she shares experiences of insomnia and coping strategies.

programme.title: Adam Kay Opens Up About The PTSD That Made Him Leave The NHS
programme.desc: Former doctor Adam Kay discusses the traumatic day at work that left him with PTSD and led to his decision to leave the NHS. He explains how the experience affected his mental health, leaving him feeling paranoid and overcautious, and how he turned to diary writing to process his emotions. Adam and Fearne discuss mental health stigma in the workplace and at home, and offer advice for building mental health toolkits for crises of varying severity. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicide.

programme.title: Patric Gagne: 5% Of People Are Sociopaths
programme.desc: Sociopathy is a spectrum disorder affecting roughly 5% of the population. Patric Gagne is a sociopath who explains the difference between psychopaths and sociopaths. While sociopaths have access to inherent emotions like sadness and happiness, they struggle with learned social emotions like remorse, guilt, empathy, and love. Patric describes the apathy she experiences, which in the past led to anti-social behaviours like stealing cars and breaking into houses.

programme.title: Ashley James On Why Are Women Still Punished for Being Difficult
programme.desc: You're a bimbo. A nag. Too mumsy. Too bossy. Far from harmless words, Ashley James is clear they all work to shrink women and girls. In this chat with Fearne, Ashley recalls her first experiences of street harassment, and the way she victim blamed herself.

programme.title: Mary Berry: How Gardening Helped Me Through Grief
programme.desc: Mary Berry has been married for 60 years and says she and her husband have never had a cross word. Her secret? Do a lap of the garden before saying the thing you might regret. In this chat with Fearne, Mary shares the simple principles that have guided her life: be kind, contribute to community, and prioritise time in nature. Mary's 91, and her mum lived to 105.

programme.title: Trump's Greenland Deal Isn't What You Think

programme.title: Trump Will Lead To America's Downfall

He examines economic, military, and moral crises, from Western support for Israel to Donald Trump and rising authoritarianism. Jones explores the legacy of Iraq, Afghanistan, and Libya, deindustrialisation, stagnant wages, and the financial crash, arguing that decades of concentrated wealth have led to decline.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Time Flies
programme.desc: We like to think we can control everything: changing the course of water, reclaiming land, replanting deserts – we constantly remodel the natural world to suit our needs. But there's one thing we can't control: the passing of time. However, we can change how we see things using cameras we can start to see the world in different time frames. Now we can see animals following the sun, mass movements of the changing seasons and even the vast impact of the changing weather. Watch what happens when time flies…

programme.title: Bucketlist Australia
programme.desc: If Australia makes you think of beaches and BBQs, cricket and cork hats, you haven't seen anything yet. Giant deserts, ancient rainforest, tropical coasts and mystical rock formations. And not forgetting some of the weirdest and most wonderful animals on the planet. From iconic kangaroos and emus to the fearsome cassowary and cuddly koalas, you can find creatures here that you'll find nowhere else on the planet. There's only one place where you can find all these bucket list encounters – Australia!

programme.title: Bucketlist South America
programme.desc: One of the biggest continents crammed with adventures and possibilities, South America should be up there on any wildlife watcher's bucket list. From record breaking rivers and longest mountain ranges to the steepest waterfalls and most massive rainforests, the variety of landscapes supports a seemingly endless diversity of wildlife. Here you can find the biggest rodents, otters and parrots, with unique mammals and marine life and spectacular predators. Make sure you don't miss South America!

programme.title: Ice Dogs
programme.desc: Conditions in the High Arctic are too extreme for either man or dog to survive alone but together we have become native to the vast white expanses. Here dogs became our greatest allies. They're our eyes, ears, strength and stamina our closest connection to a wild and unforgiving nature. In this magical yet unforgiving land, the enduring bond between human and canine goes beyond friendship to total mutual dependence. As one of the oldest breeds in the world, Greenland dogs are celebrated as the pinnacle of high performance and endurance in polar regions.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: A mesmerizing journey through the pristine waters of Raja Ampat. This Indonesian archipelago is home to some of the most beautiful and diverse marine life on the planet, including colorful fish and majestic Hawksbill Sea turtles. See the sheer beauty and vitality of this incredible ecosystem. From vibrant coral reefs and towering limestone cliffs to the dangerous ocean currents. A true celebration of nature's wonders and a powerful reminder of the importance of preserving our planet's delicate balance.

programme.title: Rottnest Island: Kingdom Of The Quokka
programme.desc: Islands worldwide are grand experiments in nature, with their isolation creating unique conditions for animals to diverge from the norm. On the far west of the Australian continent lies Rottnest Island where one of the worlds ‘happiest', yet most vulnerable marsupials the Quokka thrives. How do they survive here in such inhospitable conditions and nowhere else? In a world first, the entire life cycle of the Quokka will be filmed using special natural history filming techniques to expose the secrets of its survival mechanisms.

Swarms of bees harvest the honey from the city's almost half a million trees, while badgers can be found scurrying across courtyards and praying mantises await their prey in strips of railway land. Deep in the desert he manages to come close to the last Wild Ass, so called Onager. The horse like animals are very shy and rare. From his hideouts Benny observes chinkaras, antelopes and impressive horned wild sheep in the mountains. Passing the snow topped Mount Damavand he reaches the green north part of Iran. In the oldest national park Golestan not only massive Marals and wild boars roam. Here also Persian leopards and brown bears crossing their ways. Near the mystical forest of Persia the journey ends at the biggest inland lake of the world: the Caspian Sea. There Benny stalks on the pink flamingoes which gather there for feeding. The number and variety of species and landscapes of Iran is overwhelming but also endangered. On his photo and film expedition Benny Rebel documents the natural resources of Iran - also, to convince the government of his home country to protect their unique treasures of nature and culture.

programme.title: Berlin from Above
programme.desc: Unique pictures from above. This documentary shows a different angle of people and country, during a glide flight above the metropolis. More than 25 years after the reunion between East and West Germany, this movie shows pictures from different perspectives. Which visions and dreams marked this region? What changed and what emerged in Germany's tensed city. We take a look from above to see the city and its citizens. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to see how the people make this area their home. The movie unites nature, urbanity, tranquility and the rush of a metropolis. It unites parks and skyscraper canyons, lake capes and wetlands, curvy courses of rivers and straight streets. With exhilarating pictures we take a trip through Berlin- from sunrise til sunset. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to get a glimpse at how the people make this area their home.

programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.23

programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is acoustic musician Bily Acoustie! This artist made his debut in 2013 with the single “For A Rest.” With his trademark acoustic heartwarming sounds he won various awards at major music festivals and also quickly engraved his name in the minds of the public. That's not all thanks to his outstanding talent as a guitarist he has worked with numerous A-list musicians including Shim Soo-bong Byun Jin-seob OKDAL (also known as Rooftop Moonlight) JYJ and more creating his own genre called “Bily Acoustie.” In this episode this musician performs “One Ordinary Winter” “Days of Disturbance” “How I Love You” and more to showcase the quintessence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet Bily Acoustie!

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.

programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

Lock Stock And Two Smoking Tikkas
Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.
